description: Send RCS messages from your agent and get typed replies. Automatic SMS fallback.
name: com.cadencercs/cadence

environmentVariables.description: Your Cadence API key. A sandbox key (sk_sandbox_…) simulates delivery end to end and reaches no handset; a live key sends real messages. Get one free at https://cadencercs.com/app.html — no card, no compliance wait.
environmentVariables.name: CADENCE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the three one-way-door tools: sync_google, request_verification and request_launch. They create an agent at Google that can never be deleted, and freeze the launch questionnaire. Left unset they are absent from tools/list entirely, so no model in this configuration can reach them.
environmentVariables.name: CADENCE_ALLOW_IRREVERSIBLE

environmentVariables.description: Override the API host. Defaults to https://api.cadencercs.com.
environmentVariables.name: CADENCE_API_URL
